titles_native.title: イカロス～太陽に近づいた罪～

description:
Love and obsession between creators and their creations, crossing the line between online and offline—what awaits at the end of it all?

Anna moves to the city to become a webtoon artist, but
when she meets with Heri, her life is turned upside down.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/2186)
